# Uncovering model bias by inspecting logits

After all transformer layers have been added to the residual stream, the vector
at the last position of the input sequence is the 'prediction' of the model. The
prediction vector is then matrix multiplied by the embedding matrix to get a
vector of shape 1 x vocabulary length. This vector is called 'the logits.'

(TODO: The last sentence is true for GPT2 but Gemma and other models have a
separate unembedding matrix)
